rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Detect_Monitors() Dim TmpWin As RtSvgWindow If (Win_Mask & 1) > 0 Then TmpWin = Main_win(1) If TmpWin == Nothing Then MonFG1.fill = "black" MW1.visibility = "visible" Else MonFG1.fill = "deepskyblue" MW1.visibility = "hidden" End If End If If (Num_objects > 1) && ((Win_Mask & 2) > 0) Then TmpWin = Main_win(2) If TmpWin == Nothing Then MonFG2.fill = "black" MW2.visibility = "visible" Else MonFG2.fill = "deepskyblue" MW2.visibility = "hidden" End If End If If (Num_objects > 2) && ((Win_Mask & 4) > 0) Then TmpWin = Main_win(3) If TmpWin == Nothing Then MonFG3.fill = "black" MW3.visibility = "visible" Else MonFG3.fill = "deepskyblue" MW3.visibility = "hidden" End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event:
If (NumWin_Avail < NumMon_Avail) Then Num_objects = NumWin_Avail Else Num_objects = NumMon_Avail End If If (Num_objects == 2) Then MonBG1.Translate(4 , 0) MonFG1.Translate(4 , 0) NA1.Translate(4 , 0) MW1.Translate(4 , 0) MW1.visibility = "hidden" MonBG2.Translate(11 , 0) MonFG2.Translate(11 , 0) NA2.Translate(11 , 0) MW2.Translate(11 , 0) MW2.visibility = "hidden"
MonBG3.visibility = "hidden" MonFG3.visibility = "hidden" NA3.visibility = "hidden" MW3.visibility = "hidden" 'Для одного окна конфигурация не имеет смысла, но ее надо поддерживать ElseIf (NumMon_Avail == 1) Then MonBG1.Translate(17 , 0) MonFG1.Translate(17 , 0) NA1.Translate(17 , 0) MW1.Translate(17 , 0) MW1.visibility = "hidden"
MonBG2.visibility = "hidden" MonFG2.visibility = "hidden" NA2.visibility = "hidden" MW2.visibility = "hidden" MonBG3.visibility = "hidden" MonFG3.visibility = "hidden" NA3.visibility = "hidden" MW3.visibility = "hidden" End If If (Win_Mask & 1) > 0 Then NA1.visibility = "hidden" Else MonFG1.fill = "black" End If If (Win_Mask & 2) > 0 Then NA2.visibility = "hidden" Else MonFG2.fill = "black" End If If (Win_Mask & 4) > 0 Then NA3.visibility = "hidden" Else MonFG3.fill = "black" End If
